cues.text: How close is GPT-6-Astra to humans?
It leads the evaluated models, but still trails human performance.
Motion perception and spatial reasoning are strong.
Outcome prediction and physical dynamics still lag behind.
Which vehicle is moving faster: green or blue?
Watch how their positions change over time.
GPT-6-Astra chooses blue, correctly.
Its score on relative velocity is slightly above the human baseline.
Viewed from above, is the person turning clockwise or counterclockwise?
Counterclockwise is correct.
GPT-6-Astra nearly matches human performance on this task.
As the camera moves, where does the table end up?
Track its position relative to the moving camera.
Front-left is correct.
On this task, GPT-6-Astra is close to human performance.
Now predict the outcome.
Will this basketball shot go in?
Watch the ball's trajectory.
GPT-6-Astra says yes; the answer is no.
Humans score much higher on this task.
Ignoring the goalkeeper and defenders, will this free kick go in?
GPT-6-Astra predicts a goal.
The correct answer is no.
Will they fall left or right?
Use the person's own perspective.
GPT-6-Astra predicts left, but the answer is right.
Overall, it still struggles to predict the future.
